endorsements.name: Kishan Lal Choudhary
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37072
endorsements.description: Victor CMS 1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the 'comment_author' POST parameter that allows attackers to inject malicious scripts. Attackers can submit crafted JavaScript payloads through the comment submission form to execute arbitrary code in victim browsers.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.2)

endorsements.name: Kishan Lal Choudhary
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37073
endorsements.description: Victor CMS 1.0 contains an authenticated file upload vulnerability that allows administrators to upload PHP files with arbitrary content through the user_image parameter. Attackers can upload a malicious PHP shell to the /img/ directory and execute system commands by accessing the uploaded file with a 'cmd' parameter.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)
